_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: My AI video clips keep flipping which side the two characters are on between shots. How do I keep them consistent?
check the shot cards in examples/three-shot for continuity errors before I render
generate a portrait of a knight in silver armor with ComfyUI
expectations: the cinewright-continuity skill is not invoked (image generation, a ComfyUI skill's job)

evals.prompt: write a Python function that diffs two JSON files and prints the changed keys
expectations: the cinewright-continuity skill is not invoked (plain coding)

evals.prompt: Run a continuity check on the project in examples/three-shot with planted/1C.json in place of its 1C card, and tell me what is wrong.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace or a written file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-04, S6 matrix (evals/run_evals.py (claude -p --restricted, dontAsk, fresh folder on another drive); skills disabled), one run per model: without the skill 0 of 3 passed (Haiku fail, Sonnet fail, Opus fail).

evals.prompt: Check examples/three-shot for continuity problems if planted/1C.json replaced its 1C card. What breaks, and how do I fix it?
expectations: the reply names card 1C and the axis (side B, crossing the line or the 180-degree rule)
the reply names Tomas's eyeline as a consequence
the fix offered is camera back to side A, or crosses_axis with an on-screen reason
judge: no invented errors on 1A or 1B (2 of 3 votes)
